sentences.en: The boy said that the taxi vanished into the fog.
sentences.zh: 那个男孩说出租车突然消失在了雾中。

sentences.en: The last shred of hope had vanished from her heart.
sentences.zh: 她心中最后一丝希望已经不复存在。

sentences.en: One day, the island of Atlantis vanished into the sea.
sentences.zh: 有一天，亚特兰蒂斯岛消失在了海里。

senses.zh: 消失；突然不见；[数]成为零 -

mnemonic: 词根记忆：van（空）+ish（使…）→空无一物→不复存在
